pandas.Series.value_counts

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Count occurrences of each value or row combination. Set normalize for proportions and dropna=False to keep missing values.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

Series.value_counts(normalize=False, sort=True, ascending=False, bins=None, dropna=True)
